author: nemi
text: My badge is somewhere on the left, next to a sandwich that's honestly looking more useful than I am. The badge gets us through that door; the sandwich lets me avoid making a decision for another five minutes. Three for the badge, two for lunch. Please don't encourage me. I'm very easy to encourage.
